sectionSubtitle: Built for maximum speed, absolute privacy, and universal file conversion and compression without server costs.
badge: 100% Free • Unlimited Conversions • Zero Cloud Uploads
heroSubtitle: A completely free, 100% private client-side file converter and compressor. Transform images and documents or reduce file size instantly inside local browser memory using high-speed multi-threaded Web Workers. Zero server uploads, zero subscriptions, and unlimited batch processing.

cards.title: 100% Client-Side Privacy
cards.description: Your files never leave your device. All decoding, compression, and encoding execute entirely inside local browser memory with zero network requests or third-party telemetry.

cards.title: High-Performance Web Workers
cards.description: Leverage your multi-core processor with a hardware-concurrency Web Worker pool and Transferable ArrayBuffers for rapid parallel conversions and compression with zero main-thread UI lag.

cards.title: High-Accuracy Media & Document Conversion
cards.description: Convert and compress across essential digital assets: modern images (WebP, AVIF, HEIC/HEIF, PNG, JPG, JFIF, TIFF, PSD, ICO, SVG, BMP, GIF) and documents (Markdown, HTML, Plain Text, XML, CSV, TSV, JSON, PDF) with 99%+ fidelity.

cards.title: Instant ZIP & PDF Merging
cards.description: Bundle batch conversions into compressed ZIP archives in memory with fflate, or assemble multi-image albums into single, publication-ready multi-page PDF documents.

cards.title: Advanced Tuning & Compression Controls
cards.description: Customize your output with granular controls: quality compression sliders, black & white monochrome mode, dimension resizing, transparent background replacement, and EXIF metadata stripping.
